title: Use Cases Workspace Configuration
description: Structural schema for root/child use-cases.yml scope configuration. The core enforces root-only settings, matching schema versions across scopes, scope ownership, discovery boundaries, path containment and global resolved-ID uniqueness.

root.description: Only in the workspace root's use-cases.yml, and required there: it marks where identities start. A folder below whose use-cases.yml says root: true is a separate workspace and is never entered.

use_cases_dir.description: Scope-relative authored definition directory. The core ensures it does not escape the scope.

sign_off.description: Root only. `required`: the gate holds use cases whose promise is not approved as it reads now (chapter 16 §10). Absent: approvals are recorded and shown, never gating.
